TAPS and Mixes 654 frames connected · 3624 crosspoints · 0 trimmed off unity

A mixer of every connected frame. Each little fader is one crosspoint: the thing coming in on the top port, crossed to the port at the bottom, from -60 to +20 dB. Double-click a fader for unity. Each change lands in TRUNK-USAGE/gains.jsonl and the call's path gain.

Each frame's voice: every frame talks at once, in the accent of its country. ▶id says the country, site, frame and airport; ▶call says its connection, from and to, which it repeats the whole time it is connected (🔊 is what it puts on the wire right now). The simulators send each saying twice at the same time, cut into 1-second and 5-second chunks; here it is re-assembled, a damaged or missing second corrected from the other cut. 173914 sayings heard from 3020958 chunks · 129766 seconds corrected from the 5 s cut · 29861 lost on both · 0 unreadable chunks.
